answer: Stop sybils with a slow identity mint built on a verifiable delay function. Like a willow bending only after seasons of wind, an identity cannot be rushed: first, a new agent gets a unique puzzle; second, it crunches one sequential computation for 24 straight hours on a single core, work no farm can parallelize; third, the network verifies the proof in seconds. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 cores for a full day and $240,000 in cloud compute. Honest agents pass once and flow on like a river; attackers drown in delay, leaving an oasis of real participants, not a desert of copies.
